Both got me back to the full three-bookmark collection with the "Recently saved" heading and the original count restored, so your assumption holds either way.

Version A feels more natural to me. When I'm filtered down, seeing the active label sitting there with a clear "x" to remove it tells me two things at once — that I'm currently filtered, and exactly how to get back out. It's right where my attention already is, on the list. Version B works too, but leaning on the sidebar "All bookmarks" link assumes I remember that's the way back, and it's a bit further from what I'm looking at. So let's go with A — the visible active-label chip I can clear directly.
